stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    if h==1: c=inp[0].index(2)

    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(w)]

        if 0<=L<w: g[i][L]=2
        if 0<=R<w: g[i][R]=2
    for i in range(w):
        lo,hi=max(0,c-i+1),min(w-1,c+i)
        for j in range(lo,hi): g[i][j]=1
    return g

import os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def simulate(gi, toggle_after_bounce=True):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); seed=[j for j,v in enumerate(gi[0]) if v==2][0]
    g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # draw 2-rays: down-left & down-right, stop at wall
    def rays():
        L=R=[]
        for s in [(0,1,lambda a,a1:-1,None),'left',('left')] : pass
        # left arm
        i,j=0,seed
        while True:
            g[i][j]=2; i+=1;j-=1
            if j<0 or i>=H: break
        R=[]
        i,j=0,seed
        while True:
            g[i][j]=2; i+=1;j+=1
            if j>=W or i>=H: break
        return g
    g=rays()
    # find 2 rays, pick tip cells and simulate bounce
    tw=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==2]
    # left arm tip
    tip=[max([p for p in tw if p[1]<=seed])]
    O=set()
    if tip:
        a=max(tw,key=lambda p:p[0] if p[1]<=seed else 0)
        for tp in [next(p for p in tw if p[0]>=a[0] and p[1]<=seed), next(p for p in tw if p[1]>seed)]:
            i,j=tp; di,dj=1,-1 if p[1]<=seed else 1
            while i<H:
                g[i][j]=1
                if p[1]<=seed: dj=-1
                else: dj=1
                i+=1;j+=dj
    return g
# Simpler: from each arm tip, fire a diagonal ray in the reflected direction (flip horiz comp):

def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); seed=[j for j,v in enumerate(gi[0]) if v==2][0]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for dc in (-1,1):
        i,j=0,seed

import os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Re-derive from scratch. Demo inputs: single row with one '2' at column seed. Outputs are H=W grids (H=W since 1-row inputs? demo1 W=13,H=13; demo2 W5H5).
# Output structure: V shape of 2s (seed + two down-diagonal rays), plus 1-cells below the tip cells.
# Hypothesis to test on demos: each T cell emits a down-RIGHT ray colored 1, but ONLY IF that ray does NOT overlap another emitted ray's path — check demo1 exactly. If ambiguous, fallback rule = "rays stop when they hit a T cell or edge". Test both orders quickly.

def f(gi, order):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); seed=[j for j,v in enumerate(gi[0]) if v==2][0]
    cells=set(); 
    def ray(i0,j0,di,dj):
        i,j=i0,j0
        while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W: cells.add((i,j)); i+=di; j+=dj
    ray(seed,seed,1,1); ray(seed,seed,1,-1)
    T=cells
    g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # try processing deeper first (bottom-up) vs top-down
    sortedT=sorted(T, key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1]))[::-1] if order=='up' else sorted(T)
    for (i,j) in sortedT:
        i,j=i+1,j+1
        while 0<=i<H and 0<=j<W:
            if (i,j) in T: break
            g[i][j]=1; i+=1; j+=1
    for (i,j) in T: g[i][j]=2
    return g

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[name+' input']; o=G[name+' output']
    for ord_ in ['up','down']:
        pred=f(gi,ord_)
        diff=[(i,pred[i][j],o[i][j]) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if pred[i][j]!=o[i][j]]
        print(name,'order',ord_,'match:',not diff, diff[:6])

import os,glob,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    G={}
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])+'/../../sessions/*.jsonl')):
        txt=open(p).read().replace('\\n','\n')
        for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',txt):
            k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
            rows=[r.split() for r in txt[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
                G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if not seen[i][j]:
                v=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cells=set(); seen[i][j]=True
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cells.add((y,x))
                    for dy in (-1,0,1):
                        for dx in (-1,0,1):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==v and not seen[ny][nx]:
                                seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(cells)
    return out
